justification: Inspected byte-buddy-agent/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/ByteBuddyAgent.java:889-930 and byte-buddy-agent/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/ByteBuddyAgentAttachmentProviderTest.java:15-23.
